project: Wuxia Life Product Experience Governance Execution Pack
description: Dispatch the product-experience-governance PRD into dependency-aware execution packs for a 0-30 golden life line, active event governance, feedback and payoff standards, priority route lifecycle, experience gates, minimum playable UI clarity, and closure reporting.

userStories.title: Scope Freeze and Architecture Guardrails
userStories.description: Freeze the 0-30 golden life line scope, priority routes, non-goals, and future architecture readiness guardrails before implementation expands.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers US-001 and US-022
Defines the 0-30 golden life line and excludes full 0-80 completion
Documents orthodox/sect, wandering hero, and demonic path as priority routes
States that database, backend API, account, cloud sync, and mini-program runtime are out of scope
Preserves serializable state, data-driven events, structured choice results, and explicit save schema versioning

userStories.title: Event Asset and State Field Audit
userStories.description: Inventory runtime-loaded and non-loaded event assets, classify every event asset, define active admission rules, and audit route-like state fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers US-002, US-003, US-004, and US-014
Produces runtime-loaded and deferred or not-wired event inventories
Classifies assets as active, candidate, broken, deferred, or dead
Defines admission rules for active events
Audits route, identity, sect, faction, karma, and flag fields

userStories.title: Golden Line Spine, Feedback, and Payoff
userStories.description: Select the active 0-30 golden-line event spine, define choice feedback standards, remove vague feedback, and map key choices to later payoffs.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers US-005, US-006, US-007, and US-008
Defines a readable 0-30 golden-line timeline
Defines immediate narrative, visible impact, and future implication feedback layers
Removes vague active golden-line feedback
Produces a key-choice-to-payoff map with at least 70% payoff coverage target

userStories.title: Priority Route Lifecycle
userStories.description: Define lifecycle, beats, key choices, payoffs, failure states, and conflict rules for the three priority routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers US-009, US-010, US-011, US-012, and US-013
Defines route lifecycle states and entry, commitment, failure, and abandonment conditions
Defines orthodox/sect, wandering hero, and demonic path ages 0-30 route beats
Defines route-specific key choices and later payoffs
Produces a route conflict table suitable for tests

userStories.title: Simulation and Experience Gates
userStories.description: Create deterministic 0-30 simulation and gates for continuity, feedback completeness, route health, and active-scope quality blockers.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers US-015, US-016, US-017, US-018, and US-019
Defines deterministic simulation input and comparable output
Adds or upgrades continuity, feedback completeness, and route health gates
Distinguishes active golden-line blockers from deferred warnings
Gate failures identify exact age, event id, and choice id where relevant
userStories.notes: npm run gate:golden-line, gate:experience golden-line sub-gate; docs/test-reports/product-experience-governance-golden-line-gates.md

userStories.title: Minimum Playable UI and Closure
userStories.description: Define minimum playable layout requirements, remove debug intrusion from default player flow, update stale documentation claims, and produce governance closure reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers US-020, US-021, US-023, and US-024
Defines desktop and mobile minimum layout requirements
Keeps debug panels out of default production-like player flow
Updates or supersedes stale documentation claims
Produces closure report with completed stories, verification results, simulation results, residual risks, and architecture-readiness conclusion
userStories.notes: US-020–021, US-023–024; minimum layout, debug opt-in, doc banner, closure report
